query:
INSERT INTO profile (id, height_cm, sex)
        VALUES (1, $1, $2)
        ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
            height_cm = CASE WHEN $3 THEN $1 ELSE height_cm END,
            sex = CASE WHEN $4 THEN $2 ELSE sex END,
            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        RETURNING height_cm, sex
